topic.title: Platform User Roles
topic.shortdesc: Platform user roles define a user's primary role and available functionality in .

body.p: There are two platform user roles available, Subject-Matter Expert and Author.
A platform user role identifies the user's primary role in . It is distinct from scoped roles within an organization, a project, or review task.

section.title: Subject-Matter Expert
section.p: This is the default platform user role.
Users with this role have access only to review functionality. They can:

li.p: Access review tasks assigned to them.
Read the documents included in review tasks.

ul.li: Create and manage independent (not project-related) review tasks.

section.title: Author
section.p: This is the advanced platform user role.
Users with this role have access to the full functionality. In addition to what SMEs can do, they can:

li.p: Create and manage project review tasks.

body.p: Each platform user role is associated with a license type. provides license packages that specify the available licenses for Subject-Matter Experts and for Authors.
